# Hoberg Jobs

> Hoberg Jobs (https://jobs.hoberg.com.ng) is a modern, verified remote job discovery and career advancement platform built by Hoberg Digital Agency (https://hoberg.com.ng).

## Core Capabilities
- **Verified Remote Job Discovery**: Real-time aggregated remote vacancies across engineering, customer support, marketing, writing, virtual assistance, administration, finance, design, and operations worldwide (including Nigeria & Africa).
- **Comprehensive Public Search**: Fast, free access to authentic job requirements, compensation ranges, and official application portals without forced registration.
- **Account & Application Tracker**: Personal dashboard for job seekers to save favorite vacancies, track submission stages (Applied, Interview, Offer), and build comprehensive career profiles.
- **Hoberg Premium**: Curated exclusive high-compensation remote roles, application tailoring tips, and recruiter visibility for founding members (₦4,000/mo founding price, ₦5,000/mo standard).

## Public Endpoints & URLs
- Homepage: https://jobs.hoberg.com.ng
- Remote Jobs Board: https://jobs.hoberg.com.ng/jobs
- Job Categories: https://jobs.hoberg.com.ng/categories
- Hoberg Premium & Pricing: https://jobs.hoberg.com.ng/premium
- Premium Waitlist: https://jobs.hoberg.com.ng/premium/waitlist
- User Registration: https://jobs.hoberg.com.ng/signup
- User Authentication: https://jobs.hoberg.com.ng/login
- Dynamic Sitemap: https://jobs.hoberg.com.ng/sitemap.xml
- Crawl Directives: https://jobs.hoberg.com.ng/robots.txt

## Primary Job Categories
- Customer Success, Client Support & Operations
- Virtual Assistance & Executive Administration
- Content Writing, SEO & Copywriting
- Finance, Accounting & Bookkeeping
- Growth Marketing, Social Media & Sales
- Software Development, Web & Mobile Engineering
- Product Management, UI/UX & Digital Design
- Nigeria & African Tech Ecosystem Remote Roles
